lastCompletedStory.title: Clear implement-blocked marker on the ship merge terminal (sidecar.ts)

nextStoryContext: Added clearImplementBlockedMarkerOnMerge (src/commands/sidecar.ts, right after updatePostMergeStalledMarker) and wired it as a fourth statement (after updateShipStalledMarker/updatePostMergeStalledMarker) in makeProductionMergeWatchFn's terminal branch. Shape mirrors updateShipStalledMarker exactly: no-op unless outcome.kind === 'merged', then read the marker via readImplementBlockedMarker(markerPath) and remove it only when marker.issueId === state.issueId (MergeWatchState.issueId is string|undefined, no null-coercion needed since marker.issueId is always a plain string). updateShipStalledMarker, updatePostMergeStalledMarker, sweepOrphanedImplementBlockedMarker, and clearImplementBlockedMarkerForCurrentIssue were NOT touched (additive only), per AC4. New tests live in test/release/merge-watch.test.ts (new describe block 'clearImplementBlockedMarkerOnMerge...') covering match-clears, mismatch-leaves-intact, absent-marker-no-throw, and non-merged-terminal-is-a-no-op-even-on-match. file-size-budget.json ceiling for src/commands/sidecar.ts raised 3411->3437 with a dated _ref note for this story; test/release/merge-watch.test.ts is untracked in the budget (no ceiling entry) so no raise was needed there. Independent of US-001 (loop.ts/host.ts complete-terminal seam); both stories are now done, remaining PRD stories (if any) should be checked via prd.json.
